fixed_paragraph: When I hear a loud noise, I immediately assume something terrible has happened. When someone doesn't reply to my message right away, I start worrying that I've upset them. When I have to speak in public, I feel my heart race and my palms get sweaty. When plans change unexpectedly, I feel overwhelmed and anxious. When I make a mistake at work, I can't stop thinking about it for days. When I have a minor health issue, I worry that it might be something serious. When I see people whispering, I fear they might be talking about me. When I have too many tasks to do, I feel paralyzed and unable to start any of them. When I hear about bad news, I can't help but imagine the worst-case scenario.
